name: Goa, India
description: Coastal state known for golden Arabian Sea beaches, Portuguese colonial architecture, rich seafood culinary heritage, and spice plantations.

name: Shimla, India
description: Queen of the Hills, former British summer capital known for the historic Mall Road, Christ Church, pine-covered ridges, and UNESCO Kalka-Shimla Toy Train.

name: Manali, India
description: High-altitude Himalayan resort town famous for Solang Valley adventure sports, Rohtang Pass snow vistas, cedar forests, and Old Manali cafes.

name: Jaipur, India
description: The Pink City of Rajasthan renowned for grand Rajput forts (Amber, Nahargarh), City Palace, Hawa Mahal, and royal Rajasthani thali cuisine.

name: Kerala (Kochi & Munnar), India
description: God's Own Country featuring emerald tea estates in Munnar, historic Fort Kochi Chinese fishing nets, Kathakali art, and serene backwaters.

name: Varanasi, India
description: Spiritual cultural capital along the sacred Ganges river, famed for ancient ghats, Dashashwamedh evening Ganga Aarti, silk weavers, and street foods.

name: Udaipur, India
description: The City of Lakes celebrated for Lake Pichola boat cruises, marble City Palace, Sajjangarh Monsoon Palace, and romantic sunset rooftop dining.

name: Ooty, India
description: Nilgiri hill station renowned for emerald tea gardens, Pykara lake waterfalls, Doddabetta Peak, and the UNESCO Nilgiri Mountain Railway.
